Irrimax · Odoo Integration

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST · Base URL: https://www.irrimaxlive.com/api

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "api_key": "YOUR_IRRIMAX_API_KEY"
}

Irrimax has no login/token step, the API key is sent as a query parameter on every request.

2) Endpoint Used

GET /?cmd=getreadings&key={api_key}&name={sdb_name}&from={YYYYMMDDHHMMSS}&to={YYYYMMDDHHMMSS}
  • name: SDB file name (without path or ".sdb" extension), usually matching the logger id programmed into the probe. This is the Odoo device's sdb_name.
  • from / to: optional, YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Omitted bounds retrieve from the beginning / up to the last reading.

Response is a CSV file with one header row and one reading every 10 minutes, e.g.:

Date Time,A1(10),S1(10),T1(10),A2(20),S2(20),T2(20),...
2026/07/20 00:00:00,39.6324,2064.949,25.9167,43.51,2093.767,26.8587,...

Column families:

  • A#(depth): soil moisture at that depth (cm).
  • S#(depth): raw/scaled sensor signal at that depth.
  • T#(depth): soil temperature at that depth.

3) Odoo Configuration

Device (mdm.measurement.device):

{
  "sdb_name": "HIDROC01",
  "start_date": "2025-01-01" //optional
}
  • sdb_name: SDB file name used as the name request parameter. One device = one probe/logger (e.g. HIDROC01 .. HIDROC20).
  • start_date: default start date if none of the device's sensors has readings yet.

Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor):

{
  "column": "A1(10)",
  "start_date": "2025-01-01" //optional
}
  • column: exact CSV header name for this sensor (e.g. A1(10) for soil moisture at 10 cm, A2(20) for 20 cm, T3(30) for temperature at 30 cm, ...). Each reading row is matched against this column name so every depth is stored in its own sensor, never mixed with another depth.
  • start_date: overrides the device start date if provided.

4) Available Procedures

  • Irrimax: Daily Sync → builds the per-device sensor plan (grouping sensors by sdb_name) and downloads/upserts new readings for every mapped column.

5) Typical Workflow

  1. Build Sensor Plan → groups the configured sensors by device (sdb_name), and for each device computes the earliest from date needed (oldest last-reading among its sensors, or the configured start_date).
  2. Get Readings and Upsert → for each device in the plan, calls GET /?cmd=getreadings&key=...&name=...&from=...&to=... once, parses the returned CSV and, for every row, upserts one reading per configured sensor by reading its exact column (e.g. sensor mapped to A1(10) always reads the A1(10) column, sensor mapped to A2(20) always reads A2(20), etc.), so each depth is stored in its corresponding sensor.

6) Odoo Storage

Readings are stored in mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading, keyed by (sensor_id, measurement_time) (updates if already exists). CSV timestamps (YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM:SS) are converted to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.

7) Generated Audit File

The JSON attachment irrimax_readings_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json contains, per device: the requested URL, HTTP status, points found and the number of upserts/errors.

8) Recommendations

  • Verify that each device has a correct sdb_name and each sensor a correct column matching the CSV header exactly (including the (depth) suffix).
  • Only sensors with a column value are read; sensors without it are skipped.

plan = bag.get('devices_plan') or [] if not plan: raise Exception("No devices plan found in bag. Run 'Build Sensor Plan' first.")

total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = []
for device_plan in plan: device_id = device_plan['device_id'] sdb_name = device_plan['sdb_name'] sensor_configs = device_plan['sensors'] from_digits = ''.join(ch for ch in device_plan['from_date'] if ch.isdigit()) from_param = (from_digits + '000000')[:14] if len(from_digits) <= 8 else from_digits[:14] url = '%s/?cmd=getreadings&key=%s&name=%s&from=%s&to=%s' % ( base_api, api_key, sdb_name, from_param, to_param ) try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, timeout=timeout) if resp.status_code >= 400: items.append({ 'device_id': device_id, 'sdb_name': sdb_name, 'status': resp.status_code, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], 'url': url, }) total_errors += 1 continue csv_text = resp.text or '' if isinstance(csv_text, unicode): csv_text = csv_text.encode('utf-8') rows = list(csv.reader(StringIO.StringIO(csv_text))) if not rows: items.append({ 'device_id': device_id, 'sdb_name': sdb_name, 'status': 200, 'points_found': 0, 'upserts': 0, 'errors': 0, 'url': url, }) continue header = [col.strip() for col in rows[0]] column_index = dict((col_name, idx) for idx, col_name in enumerate(header)) date_idx = column_index.get('Date Time') if date_idx is None: items.append({ 'device_id': device_id, 'sdb_name': sdb_name, 'status': 200, 'error': "Missing 'Date Time' column in CSV response", 'url': url, }) total_errors += 1 continue upserts = 0 errs = 0 for row in rows[1:]: if not row or len(row) <= date_idx: continue date_str = row[date_idx].strip() if not date_str: continue try: ts_dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S') ts_str = ts_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') except Exception: errs += 1 continue for sensor_cfg in sensor_configs: sensor_id = sensor_cfg['sensor_id'] column = sensor_cfg['column'] col_idx = column_index.get(column) if col_idx is None or col_idx >= len(row): continue raw_value = row[col_idx].strip() if not raw_value: continue try: value = float(raw_value) except Exception: errs += 1 continue try: Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'measurement_time': ts_str}, {'value': value, 'device_id': device_id} ) upserts += 1 except Exception: errs += 1 total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs items.append({ 'device_id': device_id, 'sdb_name': sdb_name, 'status': 200, 'points_found': len(rows) - 1, 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'url': url, }) except Exception as e: items.append({ 'device_id': device_id, 'sdb_name': sdb_name, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), }) total_errors += 1 time.sleep(1)
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'to_param': to_param, 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, } b64 = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'irrimax_readings_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_') att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': Remote.id }) Remote.message_post( body=u"[Irrimax] upserts=%s errors=%s" % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id] ) bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
